finalBudget.definition:
def finalBudget (nt ns K : Nat) :=localBudget nt ns K+badCandidatesBudget ns K+
 (4*ns*ns+2*ns+2)+boundaryBudget ns nt+7*ns+9

localBudget.definition: def localBudget (nt ns K : Nat) :=admittedBudget nt ns K+localTailBudget ns K+2*ns+5

admittedBudget.definition: def admittedBudget (nt ns K : Nat) :=partitionBudget ns+(admittedGuardBudget nt ns K+2*ns+4)*10+2

partitionBudget.definition: def partitionBudget (n : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+blocksBudget n+coreBudget n+2*n+3

pendantPayloadBudget.definition: def pendantPayloadBudget (n : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+blocksBudget n+payloadCap n+2*n+3

admittedGuardBudget.definition:
def admittedGuardBudget (nt ns K : Nat) : Nat :=
 properPolynomial (nt+ns)+(16*nt*nt+8*nt+2)+earlierBudget nt ns+earlierBudget ns nt+
 admittedRule4Budget nt ns+admittedRule4Budget ns nt+cutsBudget ns+2*ns+K+
 (K+3)*(2*ns+1)+2*ns+20

earlierBudget.definition: def earlierBudget (nt ns : Nat) :=candidatesBudget nt ns+(2*ns+2)*nt+2

admittedRule4Budget.definition: def admittedRule4Budget (nt ns : Nat) :=candidatesBudget nt ns+(rule4CandidateBudget ns+1)*nt+2

localTailBudget.definition: def localTailBudget (n K : Nat) :=selectLargeBudget n K+selectSizeTwoBudget n K+selectOutsideBudget n K+4*n+5

selectLargeBudget.definition: def selectLargeBudget (n K : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+(largeAtBudget n K+4)*(2*n)+3

selectSizeTwoBudget.definition: def selectSizeTwoBudget (n K : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+(sizeTwoAtBudget n K+4)*(2*n)+3

selectOutsideBudget.definition: def selectOutsideBudget (n K : Nat) :=16*n*n+(outsideAtBudget n K+4)*n+3

outsideAtBudget.definition: def outsideAtBudget (n K : Nat) :=(outsideGuardBudget n K+2)*7+5

badCandidatesBudget.definition: def badCandidatesBudget (n K : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+(badRowBudget n K+4*n+2)*(2*n)+2

badRowBudget.definition: def badRowBudget (n K : Nat) :=cutsBudget n+(badAtBudget n K+4)*(2*n)+2

boundaryBudget.definition: def boundaryBudget (k n : Nat) :=incidentBudget k n+2*outsideCheckBudget k n+2*paintBudget k n+10

incidentBudget.definition: def incidentBudget (k n : Nat) :=64*n*n+(incidentAtBudget k n+2)*(2*n)+2

incidentAtBudget.definition: def incidentAtBudget (k n : Nat) :=2*minimalBudget k n+2*((2*n+2)*(2*n)+1)+2*n+5

outsideCheckBudget.definition: def outsideCheckBudget (k n : Nat) :=4*n*n+4*n+paintBudget k n+5

paintBudget.definition: def paintBudget (k n : Nat) :=minimalBudget k n+(2*n+2)*(2*n)+2

forestArmBudget.definition: def forestArmBudget (nt ns K : Nat) :=selectedChildrenBudget ns+5*(K+3*nt+16)+6

selectedChildrenBudget.definition: def selectedChildrenBudget (n : Nat) :=fiveChildrenBudget n+siblingChildrenBudget n n+3

siblingChildrenBudget.definition: def siblingChildrenBudget (n m : Nat) :=10*m+12+singletonChildBudget n+pendantChildBudget n+4

commonBudget.definition: def commonBudget (nt ns x : Nat) :=commonSetupBudget nt ns x+guardedBudget nt+3

commonSetupBudget.definition:
def commonSetupBudget (nt ns x : Nat) :=4*ns*ns+2*ns+2+coreBudget ns+ns+
 setupBudget (nt+ns+2) x nt+3

paidSelectedBudget.definition: def paidSelectedBudget (nt ns Kc Kl : Nat) :=finalBudget nt ns Kc+secondBuilderBudget nt ns nt Kl+3

secondBuilderBudget.definition: def secondBuilderBudget (nt ns m K : Nat) :=rowsBudget ns+(oneBudget nt m K+2)*(32*ns)+2

oneBudget.definition: def oneBudget (n m K : Nat) :=2*m+2*leafAddressBudget n+K+8
